async def async_setup_entry(
    hass: HomeAssistant,
    entry: UFPConfigEntry,
    async_add_entities: AddConfigEntryEntitiesCallback,
) -> None:
    """Set up sirens for UniFi Protect (Public API only)."""
    data = entry.runtime_data
    api = data.api

    # Sirens are only exposed through the Public Integration API. Without a
    # public bootstrap (older firmware or no API key) there is nothing to add.

class ProtectSiren(SirenEntity):
    """A UniFi Protect siren accessed through the Public Integration API."""

    _attr_has_entity_name = True
    _attr_name = None
    _attr_should_poll = False
    _attr_attribution = DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTION

        SirenEntityFeature.TURN_ON

        | SirenEntityFeature.DURATION
        | SirenEntityFeature.VOLUME_SET

    def __init__(self, data: ProtectData, siren: Siren) -> None:
        """Initialize the siren."""
        super().__init__()
        self.data = data
        self._siren_id = siren.id
        self._siren_mac = siren.mac
        self._attr_unique_id = f"{siren.mac}_siren"
        self._attr_is_on = siren.is_active
        self._attr_available = True
        self._auto_off_unsub: CALLBACK_TYPE | None = None
        self._attr_device_info = DeviceInfo(
            connections={(dr.CONNECTION_NETWORK_MAC, siren.mac)},
            manufacturer=DEFAULT_BRAND,
            name=siren.name,
            via_device=(DOMAIN, data.api.bootstrap.nvr.mac),
        )

    def _current_siren(self) -> Siren | None:
        """Return the live siren object from the public bootstrap, if present."""
        api = self.data.api
        if not api.has_public_bootstrap:
            return None
        return api.public_bootstrap.sirens.get(self._siren_id)

    def _get_siren_or_raise(self) -> Siren:
        """Return the live siren object, raising if it is no longer available."""
        if (siren := self._current_siren()) is None:
            raise HomeAssistantError(
                translation_domain=DOMAIN,
                translation_key="siren_not_found",
            )
        return siren

    @callback
    def _async_cancel_auto_off(self) -> None:
        """Cancel any pending auto-off timer."""
        if self._auto_off_unsub is not None:
            self._auto_off_unsub()
            self._auto_off_unsub = None

    @callback
    def _async_auto_off(self, now: Any = None) -> None:
        """Handle the auto-off timer firing."""
        self._auto_off_unsub = None
        if self._attr_is_on:
            self._attr_is_on = False
            self.async_write_ha_state()

    @callback
    def _async_apply_siren_state(self, siren: Siren) -> None:
        """Recompute availability/is_on and (re)schedule the auto-off timer.

        Does not write state; callers decide when to persist.
        """
        self._async_cancel_auto_off()

        if self._current_siren() is None:
            # Delete event: the siren is no longer in the public bootstrap.
            self._attr_available = False
            self._attr_is_on = False
            return

        self._attr_available = self.data.last_update_success

        status = siren.siren_status
        if (
            status.is_active
            and status.activated_at is not None
            and status.duration is not None
        ):
            delay = (
                status.activated_at + status.duration
            ) / 1000 - dt_util.utcnow().timestamp()
            if delay <= 0:
                # Already expired; the server does not emit a stop event.
                self._attr_is_on = False
            else:
                self._attr_is_on = True
                self._auto_off_unsub = async_call_later(
                    self.hass, delay, self._async_auto_off
                )
        else:
            self._attr_is_on = siren.is_active

    @callback
    def _async_updated(self, siren: Siren) -> None:
        """Handle a websocket update for this siren."""
        prev_available = self._attr_available
        prev_is_on = self._attr_is_on
        self._async_apply_siren_state(siren)
        if (
            self._attr_available != prev_available
            or self._attr_is_on != prev_is_on
        ):
